ja183:1.2: Drinking it, the donkeys became tipsy.
ja183:1.3: Whereas after drinking this fine liquor
ja183:1.4: The thoroughbreds did not become tipsy.
ja183:2.1: Having drunk just a little the low man
ja183:2.2: Taking that becomes drunk, leader of men.
ja183:2.3: The patient one, born in good family,
ja183:2.4: Drinking the finest (drink) doesn’t get drunk.
